features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
The Hunter in Darkness adds spells to your warlock spell list:

| Spell Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | bloodhound, hunter's endurance |
| 2nd | instant snare, mark prey |
| 3rd | clairvoyance, nondetection |
| 4th | harry, heart-seeking arrow |
| 5th | killing fields, legend lore |

features.name: Savage Hunter
features.description: Starting at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, its nearest ally within 30 ft must make a WIS save vs your warlock spell save DC or be frightened of you until the end of its next turn.

features.name: The Hunter in Darkness and Your Pact Boons
features.description:
At 3rd level, your pact boon is altered:

**Pact of the Chain.** Your familiar is a shadow hunting hound (wolf statistics).
**Pact of the Blade.** Your pact weapon can be a longbow or shortbow (you must provide arrows).
**Pact of the Tome.** Your tome contains creature track descriptions. Consulting it for 1 minute while inspecting tracks reveals the creature type.

features.name: Step Into Shadow
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, as a bonus action while in dim light or darkness, disappear in inky smoke and reappear in dim light or darkness within 5 ft of a creature within 30 ft of you. If that creature is frightened and you attack it, you have advantage on the attack roll. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Step Into Shadow
payload.description: While in dim light/darkness: teleport to dim light/darkness within 5 ft of a creature within 30 ft. Advantage on attacks vs frightened targets.

features.name: Strike from the Dark
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, you are immune to the frightened condition. When in dim light or darkness and you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it must make a WIS save vs your spell save DC or be frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Avatar of Death
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you reduce a target to 0 HP with a weapon attack, use a bonus action to force each ally of the target within 30 ft to make a WIS save vs your spell save DC. Fail: frightened for 1 min or until they take damage. If immune to frightened: stunned until end of its next turn. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Avatar of Death
payload.description: After reducing a target to 0 HP with a weapon attack: WIS save or allies within 30 ft are frightened 1 min (stunned if immune).
